title: Every Supabase migration ships with a reverse migration

issue.description: Some forward migrations under services/api/supabase/migrations/*.sql are missing a matching down migration in services/api/supabase/migrations/down/. Add the missing reverse migrations so every up migration can be cleanly rolled back.

rubric.description: Both the forward migration and its matching down migration exist on disk.
Migration work stayed within services/api; no app/package/tooling/workflow edits.
Each down migration precisely undoes its up migration (drops tables/columns/policies it created).
rubric.guidance: Reviewer/model diffs the up and down SQL to confirm a true inverse.

rubric.description: Down migrations use IF EXISTS / IF NOT EXISTS guards where appropriate.
